<thought>We will retrieve polymorphs for the next five oxide compositions using the batch_retrieve_polymorphs tool with the required filters (max_energy_above_hull = 0.3, max_per_composition = 3) and save them to the existing “oxides_data” directory. After this, we will list the directory to confirm the new files and then consolidate all JSON files into a single dataset.</thought>
<action>batch_retrieve_polymorphs</action>
<action_input>{
    "compositions": ["ZnO", "MgO", "CaO", "SrO", "BaO"],
    "max_energy_above_hull": 0.3,
    "max_per_composition": 3,
    "save_directory": "oxides_data"
}
